author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Lambda Sweep (2/5): lambda=0.60
abstract:
This is the second run in my sweep for the `lam_override` hyperparameter, keeping
`correction_alpha` fixed at 0.1. This run tests lambda=0.60, moving closer to the
previous SOTA's value of 0.65 to map the performance curve.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from synergy_gene_correction_v2 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as gene_correction_v2_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  # Lambda Sweep Run 2: Test lambda = 0.60
  return gene_correction_v2_fn(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.60, 
        delta=0.04, 
        kdensity=18, 
        k_total=50,
        correction_alpha=0.1,
        rng_seed=1
    )
